name: custech-fci-connect
description: CUSTECH FCI CONNECT - Digital platform for the Faculty of Computing & Informatics

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.start: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix server start
